decisions.reason: As the flagship platform closely tied to the firm's existing GIS knowledge and R&D, absorptive capacity is high and early results are interpretable, so the firm is very unlikely to drop it.
This field data capture software builds on the firm's established geospatial and mobile capabilities, allowing it to learn from early use and improve.
The search extension is close to existing web map components and benefits from in-house R&D, making it likely to be retained and refined rather than dropped.
